description: Required user flows mapped to the exact tests that prove them. landsWith names the branch that adds a test; the checker requires it only with --require-all, on a branch that contains every fix.

classes.disposable-postgres: opt-in PostgreSQL suite; run against a disposable loopback container, skipped in ordinary CI

flows.behavior: Describe through the four fields, with refusals that store nothing

evidence.test: describe opens on the four fields, and on the conversation only when chosen or already used
Continue refuses a missing name, too many places and unsafe links in plain words, and stores nothing
Keep card confirms the four fields as they read and every pencil detail in one tap

flows.behavior: Describe through a typed conversation without inventing facts

evidence.test: Talk it through keeps what was typed, lets the conversation fill blank fields, and a build clears the raw field text
keyword mode reads text on the device, keeps unknowns empty and never fabricates mapped places or languages
the typed conversation proposes a stated place by the same rule, and its Where answer wins

flows.behavior: Describe through a PDF read on the device, with explicit places proposed for review

evidence.test: PDF text extraction disables eval/WASM/font loading and cleans up on success, unread pages and abort
text attachments are read while unsupported files remain stored and explicitly unread
a place the PDF states explicitly is proposed for Where, and its words are kept
two different places or a list stay unassigned, with every source word kept
words with no stated place leave Where empty for the person to fill

flows.behavior: Source fields survive correction, Keep, removed suggestions and reload

evidence.test: a removed detail stays removed through Keep card, and a corrected one keeps the correction
review blocks unconfirmed or stale derived facts and preserves corrections and removals after a rebuild
explicit link removals cannot be reintroduced through public edits or raw forms
unfinished answer, review and link edits survive device serialization and block premature confirmation
linking the same project again suggests nothing new, and a removed suggestion stays removed
a Where the person typed or reviewed is never replaced by a place from a PDF
a place proposed from a PDF and its manual correction survive a reload of the device draft

flows.behavior: All eight kinds, equipment, amounts, negation, mixed, Portuguese, accents, soil data and living resources

evidence.test: development keeps the 80% floor, every named regression and the person's own words
the soil finding failed on the released engine and passes on the candidate
explicitly denied support is not suggested for needs or offers
kinds come from whole words in any script, so água is water and careço is not care
research and data about soil, water or land suggest Intellectual, not a living resource
actual soil, seeds and water keep Living beside data about them
a reviewed kind on soil data survives Keep, rebuilding and a device reload

flows.behavior: Private save and load bound to the signed-in account

evidence.test: checked card roundtrips without source text, files, confidence or local editors
saved list and load responses must belong to the account shown in the UI
private save and load round-trip unclassified entries while matching still requires classification
the live screen adapter saves and reloads a private card through the authenticated account handlers

flows.behavior: Switching accounts hides the previous account and keeps device work

evidence.test: new sign-in immediately hides the previous account, rechecks the cookie once and recovers without saving or loading
a card on this device belongs to the account that saved it, and is set aside for any other
a cookie changed by another tab cannot save under a different account

flows.behavior: Signing out in one tab clears private views in the others without reload

evidence.test: confirmed sign-out clears two independent tab clients and keeps device drafts and backups
two independent clients receive a real channel sign-out with no identity, tokens or private data
an unconfirmed sign-out keeps both tabs signed in and does not publish invalidation

flows.behavior: Stale responses cannot restore an old account or overwrite newer device work

evidence.test: invalidation rejects all private API responses already parsing, including stale success and auth failure
a cloud Load still in flight at sign-out cannot replace device words, files or backups
an older project discovery response cannot erase the refreshed return list

flows.behavior: Retries reuse the same request and never duplicate a write

evidence.test: save retries reuse the same request only for the same owner and checked payload
uncertain project creation retries the same reviewed intent, and unreadable state sends no new write
matching feedback replays the exact uncertain command and retains success/error and refresh feedback

flows.behavior: Device storage failure never claims a save or loses words

evidence.test: storage failure never claims a save or discards words; retry can recover without overwriting another draft
failed backup and a competing tab preserve the visible draft
device writes serialize newer input and reject a second tab's stale revision

flows.behavior: An expired Certified sign-in returns to the person's task, never the shared Site URL

evidence.test: a Certified return after Supabase's flow window goes back to the task, never to the Site URL
a stall after Certified, a revisited start and expired bridge state all return to the task
a Certified return within Supabase's window finishes the sign-in on the person's task

flows.behavior: Import, link and reuse a Certified project without duplicates or overwriting reviewed content

evidence.test: the same name points to the project, whatever its case, accents or plurals
duplicate suggestions use actual project names and only verified fields replace the device card
a checked card stays checked: the suggestions wait beside it and nothing leaves until they are kept
Use this project on a team workspace brings the source place and links, keeps them on reload and writes nothing
a place or links the person already gave the card stay theirs when a project is linked
a project without a place or links, or with a place Weave could not read, leaves Where and links empty

flows.behavior: Selective cloud and device deletion that preserves unrelated data

evidence.test: delete rejects cross-site, non-JSON, oversized, signed-out and malformed commands before the provider
a refused, unconfirmed or mismatched deletion changes nothing on the device and says why
deleting one backup by its exact key and pin removes only it; the draft and other backups stay identical
a wrong key, ID, revision or time removes nothing and says the backup changed
another account, a stale revision, a team document and bad sessions or inputs change nothing
a card anything else refers to is refused before any row is removed

flows.behavior: Sharing, matching, editing, expiry and withdrawal on synthetic fixtures

evidence.test: private Save, selected sharing, evidence, leads and returning account use the same initiative IDs
a private edit after preview invalidates that preview and an edited share requires another review
team editing shares only selected entries, invalidates edits and denies viewer commands
matches both directions with shared entries and public evidence without confusing evidence classes
only open, confirmed, unexpired entries of the other kind from another initiative are matched
public work never becomes a confirmed need or offer and never implies availability

flows.behavior: Shares, edits, withdrawal and private-entry exclusion in disposable PostgreSQL

evidence.test: matching returns only shared complementary entries from linked active workspaces
a second workspace finds only selected shares and loses them after edits or withdrawal
PostgreSQL edit/close/delete and confirmed project unlisting queue withdrawal in the private save transaction

flows.behavior: Matching quality on frozen development and independent holdout fixtures

evidence.test: every holdout result keeps its explanation and provenance; scores are not asserted in CI
frozen fixtures reject topic, text, identity and judgment leakage

flows.behavior: Funding shows the research snapshot from authoritative metadata

evidence.test: the research snapshot date follows the latest dated source check, not the whole-record research date
a snapshot with no usable research date says so instead of inventing one
